claims.detail: Committed exemplar: regulated data paths avoid public endpoints and honor regional boundaries.

findings.description: Encryption uses customer-managed keys in Key Vault; primary regulated indexes avoid cross-region replication.
findings.recommendation: Document key rotation duties and test restore with CMK-disabled failure drills.

findings.description: Diagnostic settings capture administrative actions on data stores into immutable retention storage.
findings.recommendation: Align retention with records policy and gate analyst access through PIM.
